latestVersion.changelog:
image-to-video-local-ai 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 video clips using a local AI model via cloud GPUs.
- Guided setup with automatic authentication (supports anonymous token; free credits included).
- Handles uploads, editing commands, video exports, and status or credit checks.
- Provides editing via chat instructions, including transitions, motion effects, text overlays, and audio tracks.
- Exports final videos and images in multiple formats, with download links ready in 1–3 minutes.
- Built-in error handling and workflow guidance for common use cases and troubleshooting.
